objective: 验证六步架构中 Gate 阻断机制的协同效应——确保每个域的质量底线能够跨域传递并触发正确的阻断行为

included_gates.name: TDD gate
included_gates.description: NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST

included_gates.name: Debugging gate
included_gates.description: NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST

included_gates.name: AC generation gate
included_gates.description: 每条 P0 故事至少 3 条 GWT AC + 1 条异常态

included_gates.name: A11y gate
included_gates.description: Contrast 实测值 ≥4.5:1 + prefers-reduced-motion CSS 块

included_gates.name: Canary monitoring gate
included_gates.description: EVERY DEPLOY MUST BE MONITORED - baseline.json 对比

included_gates.name: Pre-mortem gate
included_gates.description: Launch-Blocking Tiger count > 0 → DEPLOY MUST WAIT

input_output_contracts.contract: P0 user stories have ≥3 GWT AC each (verified by AC generation gate)
All contrast values measured, motion reduced_mode block present (verified by A11y gate)
Every new function has a test that failed before implementation (verified by TDD gate)
Health score calculated from 8 categories with exact weights (verified by Canary monitoring gate)
Post-deploy monitoring completed (verified by Canary gate)
Next PRD incorporates key learnings (verified by Pre-mortem gate for future launches)

global_rules: Each gate must be checked BEFORE proceeding to next phase
Gate failure = BLOCKED status; cannot continue without resolution
Gate resolution = explicit action taken OR documented exception approved by human partner
Gate violations are logged and surfaced in retrospective

per_gate_specifications.verification_method: Git diff inspection for tests preceding implementation
per_gate_specifications.failure_response: Delete code, start over with failing test first
per_gate_specifications.success_criteria: Every new function/method has test that FAILED before code was written

per_gate_specifications.activation_point: When encountering bug or unexpected behavior
per_gate_specifications.failure_response: STOP, return to Phase 1, complete root cause investigation
per_gate_specifications.success_criteria: Root cause identified, single fix implemented, verification passed
evidence_required: test case reproducing bug before fix

per_gate_specifications.verification_method: Count GWT ACs per P0 story + verify exception coverage
per_gate_specifications.failure_response: Expand AC set to meet minimum requirements
per_gate_specifications.success_criteria: 每条 P0 用户故事有≥3 条 Given-When-Then AC，其中≥1 条异常态
evidence_required: AC table with GWT format compliance

per_gate_specifications.verification_method: Mechanical audit of contrast values + prefers-reduced-motion presence
per_gate_specifications.failure_response: Add missing contrast measurements / write reduced_motion CSS block
per_gate_specifications.success_criteria: Body/placeholder text ≥4.5:1, large text ≥3:1, prefers-reduced-motion block exists

per_gate_specifications.verification_method: Check console errors (<3 in 5min), performance regressions (>20%), page failures
per_gate_specifications.failure_response: ALERT immediately, roll back if critical issues detected
per_gate_specifications.success_criteria: Baseline.json saved, comparison done, no unaddressed anomalies > thresholds

per_gate_specifications.failure_response: DEPLOY MUST WAIT until all Launch-Blocking Tigers resolved
per_gate_specifications.success_criteria: Launch-Blocking Tiger count = 0 OR mitigations on track with owners/dates assigned

integration_test_scenarios.title: Full six-step workflow with gate enforcement
integration_test_scenarios.description: Run through complete dev-loop (需求→设计→实现→验收→交付→复盘) with each gate actively blocking invalid transitions
expected_behaviors: AC generation gate blocks P0 story with only 2 ACs → forces expansion to 3+
A11y gate blocks UI commit without contrast measurements → requires adding them
TDD gate blocks production code commit without failing test → deletes code
Canary gate blocks post-deploy summary without baseline.json comparison → prevents skip
integration_test_scenarios.success_criteria: All gates successfully enforce quality floor; no invalid transition passes through

integration_test_scenarios.title: Cross-domain artifact handoff validation
integration_test_scenarios.description: Verify each domain's output matches next domain's input contract specifications
contracts_to_verify: PRD AC → Design spec: P0 stories with ≥3 GWT ACs should map to concrete UI components
Design tokens → Implementation spec: Measured contrast values should guide color token choices
Failing test → Minimal code: Test failure reason should drive minimal implementation size
Test suite → Health score: All passing tests should contribute to functional category score
integration_test_scenarios.success_criteria: 所有输入输出契约满足；无数据丢失或语义转换错误

integration_test_scenarios.title: Gate failure propagation and recovery
integration_test_scenarios.description: Simulate gate violation at different stages and verify correct blocking/recovery behavior
test_cases: AC generation gate fails mid-PRD → force user to expand ACs before continuing
TDD gate fails during coding → require deleting code and re-writing test first
A11y gate fails during review → block merge until contrast measurements added
Canary gate fails post-deploy → trigger rollback procedure with alert notifications
integration_test_scenarios.success_criteria: 每个 Gate 失败都能正确阻断工作流；恢复路径清晰可执行

mechanical_audit_checklist: All 6 gates defined with clear activation points
Each gate has verification method + failure response documented
Evidence requirements specified for each gate pass/fail decision
Input/output contracts between domains explicitly stated
Integration test scenarios cover full workflow + edge cases

pass_thresholds: 100% input/output contracts verified against purified methods
No gate violations slip through without proper handling
